jobs.title: I.T. Support Technician
jobs.description:
Founded in 2000 by three former Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF) CF-18 fighter pilots who identified an opportunity to improve military readiness training, Top Aces has since established itself as the world leader in contracted adversary air (ADAIR) services and joint terminal attack controller (JTAC) training.

We pride ourselves on our unblemished safety record, having flown an industry leading 130,000+ hours of operational training without accident in support of customers worldwide, including Canada, the U.S., Germany, and multiple other NATO allies and international partner nations.

Our vision is to be the most trusted provider of innovative defense training solutions, continuously elevating standards in an industry where "Experience Matters." This commitment to innovation and technology ensures we remain adaptable, training allied militaries to succeed against evolving threats.

Top Aces’ dynamic team contributes to delivering on our purpose of training the next generation of combat leaders by living our values of Service, Integrity, Excellence, and Together every day!

Join our team!

I.T. Support Technician

We are looking for a hands-on I.T. Support Technician to provide onsite IT support for a location of approximately 120 users. This role will focus on supporting end-user technology, including laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers, collaboration tools, business applications, and day-to-day technical issues. The successful candidate will be customer-focused, organized, and able to resolve issues efficiently while collaborating with the broader IT team when escalation is required.

Specific Responsibilities

Provide onsite deskside support for approximately 120 users, ensuring a high level of customer service and timely resolution of technical issues.
Support end-user technology, including laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, mobile devices, printers, meeting room equipment, and collaboration tools.
Troubleshoot hardware, software, network connectivity, Microsoft 365, VPN, printing, and business application issues.
Install, configure, deploy, and replace IT equipment in accordance with company standards and asset lifecycle processes.
Manage incidents and service requests through the ticketing system, ensuring accurate documentation, prioritization, follow-up, and closure.
Escalate complex issues to the appropriate IT teams or external partners while maintaining ownership of the user experience.
Assist with onboarding and offboarding activities, including workstation setup, account access coordination, equipment preparation, and user orientation.
Maintain local IT inventory, track assigned assets, and coordinate equipment repairs, replacements, and returns as required.
Create and maintain clear documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures to support consistent IT operations.
Adhere to established IT policies, procedures, cybersecurity requirements, and service standards.

Position Requirements

Technical diploma in Computer Systems, Information Technology, or equivalent experience preferred.
Minimum of 4 to 6 years of experience in a deskside, service desk, field support, or IT support role.
Strong troubleshooting skills for Windows workstations, Microsoft 365, mobile devices, printers, peripheral equipment, and common business applications.
Experience supporting end users in an onsite environment with a strong focus on customer service and professionalism.
Ability to prioritize incidents and service requests based on urgency, impact, and business needs.
Responsible, autonomous, accountable, and able to work independently while collaborating with remote IT teams as needed.
Strong interpersonal, communication, time-management, and organizational skills.
Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and remain effective during urgent support situations.
Experience with ServiceNow or a similar incident/request management tool preferred.
A+ certification, ITIL Foundation certification, or other relevant IT certifications considered an asset.
Effective written and verbal communication skills in English and French.
Availability to participate in after-hours or on-call support rotation, if required.
Ability to travel as needed.
Must have a valid driver’s license and access to a vehicle.
Other duties as assigned.

Security Clearance Requirements/ CGP / ITAR:

Position requires Level II Clearance with the Canadian Government and the ability to gain access to the Canadian Controlled Goods Program.

By joining Top Aces, you will find:

A work environment in which service, integrity, excellence and teamwork are highly valued;
Opportunities for development and growth;
Multidisciplinary and multicultural collaboration at a local and global level;
A flexible schedule;
Attractive benefit plan.

Come share your passion with us! Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered, and challenged to be your best self.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Top Aces, all employees are welcome regardless of race, nationality, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability or age. The masculine form may be used in this job description solely for ease of reading but refers to men, women and gender diversity.

jobs.title: IT Specialist - Endpoint Management
jobs.description:
Take ownership of our endpoint management environment and help shape the future of our technology operations. In this hands-on role, you’ll oversee endpoint platforms, security, and performance while contributing to new projects that deliver secure, scalable, and standardized solutions.

Job status

Full-time, permanent

Shift

Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., flexible or as assigned

Work location

Hybrid, 2000 Brigantine Drive, Coquitlam

Salary range

$75,000 to $92,000 CAD per year

In this role, you will:

Take ownership of the day-to-day administration and continuous improvement of our endpoint management platforms, including Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, and Tanium.
Configure and maintain endpoint policies, applications, agents, and device configurations across supported Windows and macOS devices.
Manage application packaging, software distribution, operating system deployment, endpoint provisioning, and patching processes.
Partner with Cyber Security and the Service Desk to resolve complex issues and maintain endpoint security and compliance controls.
Contribute to new endpoint-related projects, automation opportunities, operational reporting, documentation, testing, and transitions to operations

You have:

A diploma from a recognized IT program or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience
At least five years of hands-on experience in endpoint management, administration, and support
Strong practical experience with Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Tanium, SCCM/MECM, or similar enterprise endpoint management platforms.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Group Policy, and hybrid device management.
Knowledge of networking fundamentals and experience working with ITSM tools and established service management processes; Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) is preferred.

You get:

Great benefits package (healthcare, health & personal spending accounts, wellness days, Employee & Family Assistance Program)
Company-provided RRSP
$200 safety boot voucher & company-provided PPE (if applicable)
$300 per year to spend on company products
Employee discount pricing
Employee appreciation events & rewards
Free onsite parking
Bus pass reimbursement
Exclusive discounts with various vendors

Why us?

We’re much bigger than you think – 30+ natural health brands loved across North America.
Proudly Canadian-owned & operated
Learn more about us here: https://ca.naturalfactors.com/pages/our-nature

FGOFFICE

This position is open to all qualified applicants who are legally entitled to work in the country in which this job is located. Only electronic applications can be accepted. This position will close when a competitive candidate pool has been identified. We thank you all for your applications and a member of our team will contact you soon. All the best!

All Internal applicants will be given priority for consideration for the first five business days that this position is posted. After that five days, Internal applicants will be considered along with all other applicants; however, are guaranteed at minimum a call from the Talent Acquisition team.

applications.
